entries.title: Proverbs 5:1
segments: My son, attend unto my wisdom; Incline thine ear to my understanding:

entries.title: Proverbs 5:2
segments: That thou mayest preserve discretion, And that thy lips may keep knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:3
segments: For the lips of a strange woman drop honey, And her mouth is smoother than oil:

entries.title: Proverbs 5:4
segments: But in the end she is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:5
segments: Her feet go down to death; Her steps take hold on Sheol;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:6
segments: So that she findeth not the level path of life: Her ways are unstable, [and] she knoweth [it] not.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:7
segments: Now therefore, [my] sons, hearken unto me, And depart not from the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:8
segments: Remove thy way far from her, And come not nigh the door of her house;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:9
segments: Lest thou give thine honor unto others, And thy years unto the cruel;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:10
segments: Lest strangers be filled with thy strength, And thy labors [be] in the house of an alien,

entries.title: Proverbs 5:11
segments: And thou mourn at thy latter end, When thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

entries.title: Proverbs 5:12
segments: And say, How have I hated instruction, And my heart despised reproof;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:13
segments: Neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

entries.title: Proverbs 5:14
segments: I was well-nigh in all evil In the midst of the assembly and congregation.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:15
segments: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, And running waters out of thine own well.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:16
segments: Should thy springs be dispersed abroad, And streams of water in the streets?

entries.title: Proverbs 5:17
segments: Let them be for thyself alone, And not for strangers with thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:18
segments: Let thy fountain be blessed; And rejoice in the wife of thy youth.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:19
segments: [As] a loving hind and a pleasant doe, Let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; And be thou ravished always with her love.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:20
segments: For why shouldest thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, And embrace the bosom of a foreigner?

entries.title: Proverbs 5:21
segments: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Jehovah; And he maketh level all his paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:22
segments: His own iniquities shall take the wicked, And he shall be holden with the cords of his sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:23
segments: He shall die for lack of instruction; And in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
